user.title: Fitness (fitbridge)
user.description: Adds the Fitness page to the sidebar. It reads fitbridge's scores through the MQTT integration, which must be set up first.

init.title: Who is who
init.description: Pick the fitbridge person for each Home Assistant user. Users set to Nobody see the household read-only.
